## Tech workers

Practice moving between parts and whole: this week, map how one feature, algorithm, or metric you own affects users' wider lives and communities — the relationship work that simple metrics never capture. Consider whether investigating those relationships should become a formal part of your role, and remember James Clear's principle (*Atomic Habits*, on tomorrow's shelf): outcomes follow systems, not intentions — so design the system that makes the good outcome natural.
